protocol.experiment: 3-2: with the anchor calibration frozen, do the candidates add?
protocol.treatment: the 360 anchors are calibrated by the FROZEN AnchorResidual and then adjusted by a trainable branch that reads the top-4 leftovers of their own source block at native width

unchanged_conditions.data: the same 158 HotpotQA rows as every earlier experiment
unchanged_conditions.source_selection: V10's trained single-point leverage rule, unchanged
unchanged_conditions.core_vectors: native copies on both sides, byte-identical

protocol.only_difference: the new branch reads the top-4 leftovers of each anchor's own source block and adds a bounded residual to the calibrated anchor; the frozen stage is byte-identical to AnchorOnly

anchor_only.input: the 360 native anchors and nothing else
anchor_only.role: the frozen baseline the new branch is added to, and the arm to beat

anchor_fusion.frozen: the AnchorResidual from --anchor, digest-checked before and after training and again when this report is written
anchor_fusion.trainable: the sparse top-4 candidate branch, 524,289 parameters
anchor_fusion.fusion_mode: read from the checkpoint config; an override is recorded in identity.fusion_mode_override
anchor_fusion.selection: top-4 of each anchor's own block's leftovers by a bilinear score
anchor_fusion.width: the four winners are mixed at their native 4,096 dimensions; only the mixture is compressed
anchor_fusion.bound: vector norm: delta = raw * bound / (bound + rms(raw)), so the direction of the residual is untouched and no coordinate saturates
anchor_fusion.training: offline, answer cross-entropy on a disjoint LongBench task, 384 updates, nothing trained here

unchanged.training: the same script, data, updates, learning rate, loss, bounds

anchor_fusion.only_difference: whether the branch may read a candidate, and whose

donor.rule: the donor of a row is the previous eligible row in evaluation order (row 0 borrows row 1's window); the k-th dropped block of the sample maps to the k-th dropped block of the donor
donor.why: a gain that survives the donor swap is not knowledge: it is a generic perturbation of the anchors

protocol.success: both, not either: AnchorFusion beats AnchorOnly on the rows whose evidence the compression dropped, and AnchorFusionDonor does not
protocol.round2: not implemented: the single compression is run first
protocol.scoring: official HotpotQA QA F1, F1 >= threshold is correct, gold likelihood recorded alongside
protocol.screening_caveat: the rescue/protection groups are selected using the answer and the evidence location, so their accuracies are a mechanism diagnostic and must never be reported as a dataset score; the full-split columns are the honest reference
protocol.pairing_note: all six arms run in one process on one pre-compression window; the four old arms must reproduce the anchor-only report before the new arms are read
